# Choose your wedding in the USA or Canada, from Maui to Lake Louise

A destination wedding in the USA runs from Hawaii's beaches to Napa's vines and New York rooftops, and Canada adds Banff's lakes.
Hawaii's rules are set out below, as an example of how a licence works.
Each US state and Canadian province sets its own rules, and we check them for your date and passports.

[Button, primary: Find your destination](#places) [Button, secondary: Speak with a Wedded Advisor](#enquire)

Wedded Concierge pairs you with a Wedded Advisor who plans with you from the first enquiry to the last dance.

Not a wedding? Ask about a Hawaii proposal or honeymoon, a Banff vow renewal or a milestone birthday.

sections.heading: Picture your vows on a Maui beach, in Napa's vines or by Lake Louise
sections.body_md:
## Picture your vows on a Maui beach, in Napa's vines or by Lake Louise

Hawaii: beaches and lava coast. California: vineyards. The Rockies: lakes and snow. The South: live oaks and second lines.

### Maui and the Big Island
Resort coasts at Wailea, Kaanapali and Kapalua on Maui. On the Big Island, black sand beaches and lava fields.

### Lake Louise and Banff
A grand hotel above a lake that freezes in winter.

### Napa and Sonoma
Vineyard ceremonies among the vines.

### Charleston and New Orleans
Avenues of live oaks in Charleston. French Quarter courtyards in New Orleans.

### Aspen
A mountain town wedding in summer meadows or in the snow.

### New York City
Rooftop skylines and a portrait in Central Park.

**Local detail:** in New Orleans, a second line parade can lead your guests out from the ceremony.

[Button: Speak with a Wedded Advisor](#enquire)

## Choose the United States or Canada, then a place
(anchor: #places)

Start with the country, then the setting. Elopements and small weddings are welcome. Tell us the place on either card and we open your enquiry with it filled in.

### The United States
Destination wedding locations in the USA run from Hawaii's islands to New York City. A California destination wedding can mean Napa and Sonoma's vines or the Big Sur coast. Aspen in Colorado and Charleston in South Carolina are in the table below.
A Las Vegas wedding suits a chapel or hotel ceremony; Nevada sets its own licence rules, and your Wedded Advisor checks them before you book flights.
More places we plan: New Orleans.
Real weddings from Hawaii, New York and Colorado are below.

[Button: Plan a wedding in the United States](#enquire) (offer=United States, entry_point=place-card)

### A Canada destination wedding
Banff and Lake Louise in the Rockies, a grand hotel above the lake and mountain ceremonies in summer or snow.
More places we plan: Vancouver and Toronto.
Real weddings from Vancouver and Toronto are below.

[Button: Plan a wedding in Canada](#enquire) (offer=Canada, entry_point=place-card)

Planning Mexico or the Caribbean? See [weddings in Latin America and the Caribbean](/destinations/latin-america-caribbean).

sections.heading: Compare the places couples ask about most
sections.body_md:
## Compare the places couples ask about most
(anchor: #compare)

Ten destination wedding locations in the USA and Canada, side by side, with legal and travel steps linked to the official rules below.

| Place | Style | Legal steps by passport | Family or adults-only fit | Next step |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Maui | Beach resort | Hawaii licence, same steps for every passport (below) | Large family weeks or adults-only resort stays | [Ask about Maui](#enquire) |
| Big Island | Beach and lava coast | Hawaii licence, same steps for every passport (below) | Smaller groups who want space | [Ask about Big Island](#enquire) |
| Kauai | Sea cliffs and gardens | Hawaii licence, same steps for every passport (below) | Intimate weddings and elopements | [Ask about Kauai](#enquire) |
| Napa and Sonoma | Wine country | See note | Adults-led dinners; families welcome | [Ask about Napa and Sonoma](#enquire) |
| Big Sur | Coastal cliffs | See note | Elopements and small groups | [Ask about Big Sur](#enquire) |
| New York City | City | City Clerk weddings by appointment only | City weekends for any age | [Ask about New York City](#enquire) |
| Aspen | Mountains | See note | Families in summer, ski groups in winter | [Ask about Aspen](#enquire) |
| Charleston | Southern charm | See note | Multi-generation family weekends | [Ask about Charleston](#enquire) |
| Las Vegas | City and chapels | See note | Couples and small groups | [Ask about Las Vegas](#enquire) |
| Banff and Lake Louise | Mountains and lakes | See note | Families in summer, couples in winter | [Ask about Banff and Lake Louise](#enquire) |

Table note: Rules are set by each state or province; we check them for your date.

Table caption: Style and fit are our planning notes, not venue claims. Entry rules for US, UK and Australian passports are in "Travel by passport" below.

Arriving: Hawaii flights usually land at Maui (OGG), the Big Island (KOA or ITO), Kauai (LIH) or Honolulu (HNL). Banff is about 1.5 hours by road from the airport. We confirm routes and transfers for your guests.

CMS note: each 'Ask about' link opens the form with Place prefilled (offer=<place>, entry_point=compare-table). No price column and no flights column (no flight-time fact in the ledger). The airport line rests on proposed F051 and F052 (research doc, unconfirmed).

### Marry legally in Hawaii
(anchor: #hawaii-licence) Last checked October 2026, [Hawaii Department of Health](https://health.hawaii.gov/vitalrecords/marriage-licenses/)

The steps are the same for US, AU and UK passports. There is no state residence or US citizenship requirement, no blood test, and both partners must be 18 or over.
1. Apply online and pay, then meet a State-authorised agent together, in person, with government photo ID. A passport is accepted; proxies are not.
2. Collect the licence no sooner than 30 days before the ceremony. There is no waiting period once it is issued, and it is valid for 30 days, in Hawaii only.
3. Your officiant must hold a licence from the State of Hawaii Department of Health.
[APPLY AFTER SIGN-OFF: F027, Nic] The state fee is USD 65, non-refundable.
[FALLBACK UNTIL THEN] Your Wedded Advisor confirms the current state fee before you apply.

### Every other state and province
Each US state and each Canadian province sets its own licence rules. We check the current steps with the issuing office for your date.

In New York City, licences and City Clerk ceremonies are by appointment only, with no walk-ins. Source: [NYC City Clerk marriage licences](https://www.cityclerk.nyc.gov/content/marriage-license), last checked October 2026.

UK citizens: whether you can marry depends on local law, and you may need documents showing you are free to marry. Source: [GOV.UK marriage abroad in the USA](https://www.gov.uk/marriage-abroad/y/usa).

### Travel by passport
(anchor: #entry) Last checked October 2026
- **US passports:** no travel authorisation for Hawaii or the mainland. For Canada, no tourist visa for stays under 180 days. Fly on a passport: the passport card is not valid for flights. Source: [US State Department advice on Canada](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/international-travel/International-Travel-Country-Information-Pages/Canada.html).
- **UK passports:** for the US, an ESTA under the Visa Waiver Program, or a visa, for visits of 90 days or less. The programme needs an unrestricted right of abode in the UK. Source: [Visa Waiver Program rules](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/us-visas/tourism-visit/visa-waiver-program.html). For Canada, an eTA to fly in; none by land or sea. Source: [GOV.UK Canada entry requirements](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/canada/entry-requirements).
- **Australian passports:**
[APPLY AFTER SIGN-OFF: F038, F041, Project Lead (human)] Australian guests travel to the US on an ESTA under the Visa Waiver Program, and need an eTA to fly into Canada.
[FALLBACK UNTIL THEN] Australian guests should check ESTA eligibility on the official US site and eTA rules on the official Canadian site before booking.

[APPLY AFTER SIGN-OFF: F045, Project Lead (human)] Hawaii weddings run year-round. Most of the mainland and Canada favour May to October, and mountain winter weddings run December to March.
[FALLBACK UNTIL THEN] Hawaii, the mainland coasts, the mountains and Canada each run on different seasons. Tell us your month and we check weather, rates and availability for it.

sections.heading: See how planning with us works
sections.body_md:
## See how planning with us works
(anchor: #advisor)

Wedded Concierge pairs you with a Wedded Advisor who plans with you from the first enquiry to the last dance.

1. **Tell us where and when.** Share the place, month, guest count and style in the form below. Every enquiry goes to Wedded Concierge.
2. **Talk it through.** Your advisor explains your options, the legal route for your passports and what drives cost.
3. **Shortlist places and venues.** Together you narrow the region to a place, then to the venues that fit your guests.
4. **Sort the legal and travel steps.** We check the licence rules for your state or province and point your guests to the official entry rules for their passports.
5. **Plan the guest experience.** Travel, rooms and a guest website so everyone knows where to be.

Wedded Privileges: ask us what the programme offers. [See how Wedded Concierge works](/wonderland-concierge).

sections.heading: Tell us where you are thinking of going
sections.body_md:
## Tell us where you are thinking of going
(anchor: #enquire; form posts to /api/concierge/enquiry)

Tell us the place, month and guest count, even if nothing is fixed yet. Every enquiry goes to Wedded Concierge.

**Visible fields (label, then options or placeholder):**
- First name (required)
- Last name (required)
- Email (required)
- Phone (optional)
- Where are you thinking?: United States | Hawaii | Canada | Not sure yet
- Place (optional): Maui | Big Island | Kauai | Napa and Sonoma | Big Sur | New York City | Aspen | Charleston | Las Vegas | Banff and Lake Louise | Somewhere else
- What style suits you?: Beach | Wine country | Mountains | City | Southern charm | Not sure yet
- Month (optional): January to December | Not sure yet
- Year (optional): 2027 | 2028 | 2029 or later | Not sure yet
- How many guests?: Just the two of you | Up to 30 | 31 to 80 | 81 to 150 | Over 150 | Not sure yet
- Family or adults-only?: Family-friendly | Adults-only | Either
- What are you celebrating?: Wedding | Elopement | Proposal | Honeymoon | Vow renewal | Milestone birthday | Family gathering | Something else
- Checkbox: I am a hotel or travel advisor enquiring for a client
- Anything we should know? Placeholder: Dates you have in mind, passports in your group, anything else

**Button:** Send your enquiry

**Consent line (under the button):** By sending this form you agree to our [Privacy Policy]([URL to confirm]).

**Error messages:**
- First name empty: Please add your first name
- Last name empty: Please add your last name
- Email empty: Please add an email we can reply to
- Email not valid: Please check your email address
- Submit failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

**Success state:**
- Heading: Thank you
- Body: Your enquiry is with Wedded Concierge. We will be in touch to talk through your plans for the USA or Canada.

**Hidden fields:**
- route_to = wedded-concierge
- destination = North America
- page_slug = /destinations/north-america
- offer = place or card name when the form is opened from a place card or table link, otherwise blank

faq.q: Where is the most popular wedding destination in the United States?
faq.a: Many couples start with a Hawaii destination wedding, but the best destination wedding locations in the US depend on your style. For beaches, Maui, the Big Island or Kauai. For wine country, Napa and Sonoma. For mountains, Aspen, or Banff over the border in Canada. For Southern charm, Charleston. For cities, New York or Las Vegas.

faq.q: Should you marry in the USA, in Canada or further abroad?
faq.a:
Choose the place most of your guests can reach easily. US guests need no travel authorisation for a US wedding, and no tourist visa for Canada for stays under 180 days. UK guests need an ESTA or a visa for the US, and an eTA to fly into Canada, so allow more planning time.
[APPLY AFTER SIGN-OFF: F038, F041, Project Lead (human)] Australian guests travel to the US on an ESTA under the Visa Waiver Program, and need an eTA to fly into Canada.
[FALLBACK UNTIL THEN] Australian guests should check ESTA eligibility on the official US site and eTA rules on the official Canadian site before booking.
[Travel by passport](#entry) sets out each step.

faq.q: Where can I get married with just the two of us?
faq.a: Hawaii suits a small ceremony: there is no residency rule and no waiting period once your licence is issued. You apply online, then appear together in person, and we confirm what the ceremony needs, such as your licensed officiant. Kauai's cliffs, Big Sur's coast and the lakes of Banff suit a small ceremony too. Choose "Just the two of you" in the form and we plan around it.

faq.q: Is a destination wedding legal in the US?
faq.a: Yes, when you follow the licence rules of the state where you marry. Each state sets its own, and we check them for your date. Hawaii, for example, has no state residence or US citizenship requirement, and the licence is valid only in Hawaii. UK citizens should also check the documents they need to show they are free to marry.

faq.q: Where in the US can you get married immediately?
faq.a: In Hawaii, there is no waiting period once your marriage licence is issued. You both still apply online and appear together in person, and you collect the licence no sooner than 30 days before the ceremony. Every other state sets its own rules, and we confirm them for your date.

faq.q: Do Australian and UK guests need travel authorisation?
faq.a:
US guests need no tourist visa to visit Canada for stays under 180 days; fly on a US passport. UK guests need an ESTA under the Visa Waiver Program, or a visa, before travelling to the US, and an eTA to fly into Canada (last checked October 2026).
[APPLY AFTER SIGN-OFF: F038, F041, Project Lead (human)] Australian guests travel to the US on an ESTA under the Visa Waiver Program, and need an eTA to fly into Canada.
[FALLBACK UNTIL THEN] Australian guests should check ESTA eligibility on the official US site and eTA rules on the official Canadian site before booking.

faq.q: What is a realistic budget for a destination wedding?
faq.a: A realistic budget depends on four things: the place, the season, your guest count and how far your guests fly. Share your guest count and month in the form, and your Wedded Advisor talks you through what drives the cost for your plans.

The cost of a Hawaii wedding depends on what you choose. Some couples want one hotel to handle the ceremony, dinner and rooms; others prefer to choose each part separately. Share your guest count and style in the form, and we talk you through both routes.

faq.q: When is the best time to marry in Hawaii, the mainland or Canada?
faq.a: The best month depends on where you marry, because Hawaii, the mainland coasts, the mountains and Canada each run on different seasons. Tell us your month and your Wedded Advisor checks weather, rates and availability for it.

faq.q: Can Wedded Wonderland plan a wedding in North America?
faq.a: Yes. Wedded Concierge plans weddings across the United States and Canada, from Hawaii to Banff. Tell us the place, month and guest count in the form, and a Wedded Advisor plans with you from there. Ask what Wedded Privileges offers.
